        s = s + (1.0 - f.tm_regstaged) * w[11]

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    sm = np.maximum(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(f.tm_dram_ratio))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    s = s + f.wave_tail_occupancy_deficit * w[0]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        s = s + np.log2(f.operand_coalescing_aspect) * w[1]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_l2_pressure) * w[2]
    else:
        s = s + (1000.0 * f.cta_barrier_density) * w[3]
        s = s + (f.tm_cta_warps - 1.0) * w[4]
    if p.output_parallelism_deficit > 0.001:
        s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[5]
        s = s + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[6]
        s = s + f.splitk_roofline_log_time * w[7]
    else:
        s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[8]
        s = s + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio * w[9]
        s = s + f.accumulator_reduction_work_ratio * w[10]
        s = s + f.splitk_roofline_log_time * w[11]
    if p.async_alignment_deficit < 1.0:
        s = s + f.tm_regstaged * np.maximum(f.pipeline_stage_time_ratio - 1.0, 0.0) * w[12]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    sm = np.maximum(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(f.tm_dram_ratio))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    s = s + f.launch_tail_deficit * w[0]
    s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[1]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[2]
    else:
        s = s + np.log2(f.warp_output_work) * w[3]
    s = s + f.tm_regstaged * w[4]
    if p.vector_alignment_deficit > 0.05 or p.log_min_dim < 8:
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[5]
        s = s + f.shared_memory_pressure * w[6]
    else:
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[7]
        s = s + f.shared_memory_pressure * w[8]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    sm = np.maximum(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(f.tm_dram_ratio))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    s = s + f.instruction_work_density * w[0]
    s = s + f.barrier_work_density * w[1]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1.0:
        s = s + f.operand_stride_transaction_ratio * w[2]
        s = s + f.contiguous_store_lane_deficit * w[3]
    else:
        s = s + f.operand_stride_transaction_ratio * w[4]
        s = s + f.contiguous_store_lane_deficit * w[5]
    s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[6]
    s = s + f.splitk_roofline_log_time * w[7]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio) * w[8]
    s = s + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[9]
    if p.output_parallelism_deficit < 0.001:
        s = s + f.shared_memory_pressure * w[10]
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[11]
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[12]
    else:
        s = s + f.shared_memory_pressure * w[13]
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[14]
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[15]
    s = s + np.log2(f.warp_instruction_issue_count) * w[16]
    return s
